logline: A baby piglin catches a gold ingot that falls from the sky every six seconds and is saving all of them for a bastion of its own, grateful to the generous stranger up there who keeps giving it gifts, until we see the stranger's barter farm: the baby is stuck in the cell, and babies never barter.
question: why tf does gold fall on this baby piglin every six seconds?
premise: In the Nether by the Portal Cottage's portal, a player (efe skin) built a barter farm: a dropper drops one gold ingot every six seconds onto a one-piglin cell, the piglin barters, the hoppers carry the barters to a chest. A baby piglin chased an ingot down the farm's catch hole and landed in the cell. It thinks the cell is its room, the gold is a gift from a generous stranger, and it is saving up for a bastion of its own, for when it's big.
twist: The baby is the jam in the player's barter farm. Babies take gold and never barter (they keep it), so the farm has made nothing: every fix the player tried (a new hopper, a lava moat, a PLEASE WORK sign) the baby read as a present. The reveal is the picture: the farm's output chest open and empty under the hopper floor, the baby above it hugging an ingot as the dropper clicks out another. Fans' second layer: baby piglins never grow up, so 'for when I'm big' never comes.
payoff_note: `drop`: the stunt mark when the dropper fires the next ingot in S11, on 'SIX'; the Short ends <= 1.0 s after it (owner: cut right on the reveal). No line after L12.

world.place: portal_cottage_nether (new, claimed on this branch; the lead merges claims): the Nether side of the Portal Cottage's cellar portal, about (-16, 80, -118) in Nether coordinates (the cellar portal / 8). A netherrack shelf over a lava lake under a netherrack cliff; the portal that formed when Grandpa walked through (day ~175) on the shelf; the player's barter tower built against the cliff about 10 blocks east; a bastion remnant across the lake (unsurveyed: the build places it with /place structure if the seed has none in the footprint).
world.canon: Not Buh's story; nobody from the Portal Cottage appears. The player is a new, nameless player (efe skin, conflict 18). He finished the farm on day ~4998; the baby was its first catch, so the chest has never had anything in it. The piglins crowd this shelf because a gold ingot comes out of the portal every night (Grandma's, Gold for the Portal): that is why he built here. Never said. The baby never grows up (vanilla).
world.easter_egg: helmet_piglin: among the adults in S04 (frame left, mid-ground), an adult piglin in a gold helmet with a blue (lapis) trim: Grandpa's helmet from Gold for the Portal (it wears it from day ~175; Gold's day 9300 is still to come). Never named, never centred.

lines.text: Every SIX seconds, / a gold INGOT / falls from the SKY. / I've kept / all FOUR HUNDRED.
lines.say: Every six seconds, a gold ingot falls from the sky. I've kept all four HUNDRED.
lines.direction: proud and amazed, one quick breath; the number lands

lines.text: The grown-ups / out there / STARE at me / SO hard. / They're just / JEALOUS.
lines.say: The grown-ups out there stare at me so hard. They're just JEALOUS.
lines.direction: a smug little giggle, not scared at all

lines.text: I'm saving up / for a whole BASTION. / For when / I'm BIG.
lines.say: I'm saving up for a whole bastion. For when I'm BIG.

lines.text: Somebody / up there / THREW me / the first one. / I chased it / down a HOLE.
lines.say: Somebody up there threw me the first one. I chased it down a HOLE.
lines.direction: delighted, like finding a secret clubhouse

lines.text: He's still / up there. / He's SO / GENEROUS.
lines.say: He's still up there. He's so GENEROUS.

lines.text: He gave me / a shiny / new FLOOR.
lines.say: He gave me a shiny new FLOOR.

lines.text: A MOAT / of LAVA, / like a real / CASTLE.
lines.say: A moat of lava, like a real CASTLE.

lines.text: And a NOTE. / I can't READ. / But I think it says / I LOVE YOU.
lines.say: And a note. I can't read. But I think it says I love YOU.

lines.text: The grown-ups / give their gold AWAY. / For GRAVEL. / FOOLS.
lines.say: The grown-ups give their gold away. For gravel. FOOLS.

lines.direction: fed up, flat, staring into a box

lines.text: He LOVES gravel. / Grown-ups / are SO weird.
lines.say: He loves gravel. Grown-ups are SO weird.

lines.text: So I hug my GOLD, / and I count / to SIX.
lines.say: So I hug my gold, and I count to SIX.
lines.direction: cosy and content, counting under its breath on the last word
